newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares fight back, but still close lower.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares fight back, but still close lower.

text.p: Danish share prices closed lower on Thursday after recovering from early falls with the market in positive mood ahead of Friday's important U.S. August jobless data.
"Friday looks a bit dull but things should brighten up when the U.S. unemployment data come," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index lost 0.15 point to 120.05 in overall bourse turnover of 914 million crowns. The KFX September future fell 0.15 point to 120.05 with 89 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
ISS was once more the day's most traded paper, with 308,000 shares changing hands to close unchanged at 159 on top of days of gains.
FLS Industries continued its onward march, the B-share putting on another 15 crowns to finish at at 735.
Moeller stock fell back, D/S Svendborg shedding 5,000 crowns and twin D/S 1912 2,500 to end the day at 202,000 crowns and 140,000 crowns respectively.
